subject: biology

hotspots.label: Phloem tube
hotspots.description: A living tube of the phloem bundle that carries sugar food from the leaves to the rest of the plant.
hotspots.positionHint: A green-tinged vertical tube within the bundle, with golden sugar droplets moving down.
hotspots.function: Carries food (sugar) from the leaves around the plant.

hotspots.label: Leaf food source
hotspots.description: The leaf where food is made at the top and enters the phloem.
hotspots.positionHint: The leaf at the top of the slice where golden droplets appear first.
hotspots.function: Produces the sugar food that phloem carries.

hotspots.label: Root sink
hotspots.description: The root below that receives some of the food the leaves made.
hotspots.positionHint: The root located at the base where food droplets arrive.
hotspots.function: Uses and stores some of the leaves' food.

hotspots.label: Seed sink
hotspots.description: A seed that receives food for its own stored energy.
hotspots.positionHint: A round seed at the bottom branch where golden food dots gather.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A clean stylized diorama - pale green phloem tubes with golden food dots, muted greens and creams, not cartoon, not cluttered, no glow. Strong color reserved for the hotspot dots and food dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.5-0.65. Food droplets are simple spherical, not emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a vertical slice of plant showing the phloem as a bundle of green-tinged tubes, with tiny golden sugar droplets moving downward from a leaf at the top, dividing to reach a root at the base and a seed at the side. Named nodes: StemSlice, PhloemBundle, LeafSource, RootSink, SeedSink, FoodDrops. Budget 10-14k.
